hypotheses.justification: Split on f = 0. In the zero case, Place.ord_zero (Definitions/Def_AlgebraicCurve_DivisorClassGroup.lean) and hDf give Df v = 0 for every v, hence Df = 0 by Finsupp extensionality; both sums are zero, including for empty sets. In the nonzero case, the existing proof applies unchanged.
